form:FormGroup.label: Rule Name (optional)
form:FormGroup.helpText: An optional name to help you tell rules apart. It does not affect which data the rule matches.

form:FormGroup.label: Retain For
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to keep data matching this rule, measured from when it was created. Enter a number from 1 to 9999 and choose a unit from minutes to years. Older data is deleted.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number from 1 to 9999 and a unit; older data is deleted.

form:FormGroup.label: Expression
form:FormGroup.helpText: Selects the data this rule applies to, using stream meta fields. Only the matching rule highest in the list (the highest rule number) applies; data that matches no rule is kept.
